subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu add a supported inbound attachment-content opt-out, and what should the canonical config name and default be?
rationale: The current key is undocumented and unparsed, while adding it would create a new plugin-owned config/default surface that affects context behavior and upgrades.

options.title: Add a Feishu-owned opt-out
options.body: Add a documented top-level/per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

options.title: Use a shared channel policy
options.body: Create or reuse a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one canonical shape across channel plugins.

options.title: Document unsupported config
options.body: Document that Feishu currently supports `mediaMaxMb` but not a content-ignore switch, then close the expectation as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Add a Feishu-owned opt-out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level/per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the strongest recent Feishu media/docs history from PR #47968 and is best positioned to choose the channel policy shape.
